question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d357e3bfa098b56184c91107ac9214c1e7ec3d8220664f51b57d64cf83ae6bb6.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) Outer figure → The number of sides is decreasing subsequently.

2) Inner figure → The number of sides is increasing subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ccd53064f7afaa6edb9d36aa20b02b07783bbdd3c20d239201a3549d7fa2955.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2db834ae3e7e19238704ec1693122109c4eed5adaa46441052f901f38c33b8cc.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
